Flying around in that ugly ship of yours, stealing and killing to live.''"
"''We ''like'' that ship. And we like stealing and killing too.|Qi'ra and [[Ren (human)|Ren]]|[[Crimson Reign 4|''Crimson Reign'' 4]]}} The '''''Night Buzzard''''' was a modified [[Oubliette-class transport|''Oubliette''-class transport]] used by the [[Knights of Ren]]. The Knights made several alterations to the ''Night Buzzard'' to better suit their tastes, such as altering the [[Starship|vessel's]] appearance to match their [[Dark side of the Force|dark side]] aesthetic. The vessel's [[engine]]s were also crudely modified to generate more thrust, although this took a toll on the insulation baffles, causing the ''Buzzard'' to spew noxious [[gas]] as it flew. It was well [[Weapon|armed]], with a forward [[laser cannon]] [[turret]], a mid ship [[laser]] [[cannon]] turret, a rear [[heavy laser cannon]] turret, and rear-facing fixed laser cannons. The Knight [[Kuruk]] served as the [[pilot]] of the heavily armed ship. ==Description== [[File:TheNightBuzzard-TheDarkTech.png|thumb|250px|left|The ''Night Buzzard'']] At first, the [[Starship|ship]] was very different than what it was under the [[Knights of Ren]]. It had light anti-personnel [[weapon]]s, designed to put down [[prison]] riots, medical stasis pads for high-danger [[prisoner]]s, and rear prison cells for low-danger prisoners. These sections were replaced by ship-to-ship [[cannon]]s, an [[interrogation]] room, and personal quarters. The Knights also augmented the [[engine]] with heat-sink insulator pads to avoid detection. Ebon [[armor]] covered the ship, giving it a look of intimidation and blocking sensors.''[[Star Wars Complete Vehicles, New Edition]]'' ==History== Originally a [[Prison ship|dungeon ship]] on [[Osseriton]], a penal world in the [[Unknown Regions]], the vessel was liberated by the Knights during a [[Raid on Osseriton|raid]] on the [[planet]] alongside many prisoners, becoming the home and [[transport]] for the Knights. [[File:NightBuzzardEngines-SWCT.png|thumb|left|250px|The modified engines of the ''Night Buzzard'']] The Knights heavily modified the ship. First, they removed the front prisoner area and replaced it with a midship interrogation center. The rear prison cells, designed for low-risk prisoners, became the personal quarters of the Knights. [[Ren]] opted for no quarters, and [[Ben Solo|Kylo Ren]] followed this ideal. The overall armor was modified to better suit their style. The Knights of Ren used the ''Night Buzzard'' to travel to [[Pasaana]], where they captured an unsuspecting [[Chewbacca]]. They then followed [[Resistance]] members [[Rey Skywalker|Rey]], [[Poe Dameron]], [[Finn]], [[BB-8]], and [[C-3PO]] to [[Kijimi]], where they alerted their master, Kylo Ren. They were then called to [[Exegol]], where the Knights were killed by their former leader, now redeemed as Ben Solo. {{Ship-stub}} ==Appearances== *[[Crimson Reign 1|''Crimson Reign'' 1]] *[[Crimson
